molecular_weight_Da.comment: Average mass. Lys 146.19 + Pro 115.13 + Val 117.15 - 2 x H2O (36.03) = 342.44 g/mol. Molecular formula C16H30N4O4. Consistent with PubChem KPV entry. Monoisotopic ~342.23.

net_charge_pH7p4.comment: N-terminal alpha-amine (+1) + Lys epsilon-amine (+1) + C-terminal carboxylate (-1) = net +1 at physiological pH. Xia 2021 reports favorable conduit electrostatics for cationic versus negatively charged cargo in the studied comparisons, but it does not determine a KPV-specific permeability multiplier.

hydrodynamic_radius_nm.comment: Estimated for a 342 Da tripeptide. Stokes-Einstein back-calc from D~5e-6 cm2/s gives r_h ~0.5 nm; the declared 0.45-0.60 nm band crossed with the declared 5.0-10.75 nm pore-radius band gives lambda = r_solute/r_pore of approximately 0.04-0.12. The corresponding simple steric partition term (1-lambda)^2 is approximately 0.77-0.92. These estimates motivate sensitivity rather than a claim of zero hindrance.

aqueous_diffusion_coefficient_m2_per_s.comment: 5e-10 m2/s = 5e-6 cm2/s. Stokes-Einstein: D = kT/(6*pi*eta*r_h) with eta_water(37C)=0.69e-3 Pa.s, r_h=0.5 nm, T=310K -> D = (1.38e-23*310)/(6*pi*0.69e-3*0.5e-9) = 6.6e-10 m2/s. At 25C (0.89e-3 Pa.s) -> 4.5e-10. Central 5e-6 cm2/s is the standard order for a ~340 Da solute; range 4-6e-6 cm2/s brackets temperature and r_h uncertainty. This is a low-sensitivity parameter because access resistance (which scales as 1/D too) and pore permeability both scale linearly with D, so the equilibration time constant scales as 1/D uniformly.

pore_hindrance_factor.comment: Dimensionless engineering sensitivity applied to the neutral diffusive permeability. Central 1.0 assumes no net hindrance. The lower bound 0.5 is a conservative design case covering unresolved steric, partition, and electrostatic effects; it is not a measured KPV/GSDMD value. Values above 1 from favorable electrostatic partition are not credited.

enzymatic_resistance_note: Intracellular KPV degradation is not characterized in the cited evidence. The healthy-cell comparator does not claim a measured retention time or degradation rate. Any inference that extracellular or serum stability transfers intracellularly remains conditional and is excluded from the model.
